title: Singer Sombr Brings Out His Music Hero
summary:
Fans at a concert in Los Angeles got a big surprise on Saturday night. The singer Sombr brought out a special guest at the Kia Forum. It was Lindsey Buckingham, a guitarist and singer from the famous band Fleetwood Mac.

Sombr told the crowd how much Buckingham means to him. "This man's music is one of my biggest influences," Sombr said. "I grew up on this guy." He also called Buckingham a great mentor. A mentor is someone who helps and teaches you.

Together, they played the Fleetwood Mac song "Go Your Own Way."

There was another surprise, too. Jesse Rutherford from the band the Neighbourhood sang "Sweater Weather" with Sombr.

Sombr's tour will keep going for a long time. He will play two shows at Madison Square Garden in New York in November. Then he will travel to Mexico, South America, Australia and Europe. The tour is set to end on July 17, 2027, in Berlin, Germany.
why_it_matters: It shows that the music you love as a kid can inspire what you do when you grow up.
